candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) instead of _owner.
Change owner() to return msg.sender instead of _owner.
Change owner() to return tx.origin instead of _owner.
Change owner() to return address(this) instead of _owner.
Remove the require check that newOwner is non-zero, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) and thus changing ownership after calls.
Invert the require to forbid non-zero addresses (only allow setting owner to zero), changing resulting owner after calls.
Change onlyOwner to check caller is NOT the owner, inverting the guard so transferOwnership can be called by non-owners and altering ownership outcomes.
Make transferOwnership callable without onlyOwner guard by removing the modifier, allowing anyone to change owner.
Change paused() to return the negation of the stored _paused flag so callers observe the inverse paused state.
Make paused() always return true regardless of the stored _paused flag.
Make paused() always return false regardless of the stored _paused flag.
Change setKeeper to assign keeper to address(0) instead of the provided _keeper (so keeper differs after call).

Change setKeeper to emit the event with the old keeper instead of the new one, and assign keeper to the provided _keeper (event differs but keeper assignment remains) — does not change keeper value, so omitted (not included).

Modify onlyOwner to check against a different comparer (msg.sender != address(0)) so ownership guard is removed and setKeeper can be called by anyone, potentially changing keeper after call by different caller.
